description: Reads mail campaigns, recipients, delivery analytics, cost estimates, designs, pricing, or wallet balance. Free. Campaign status is draft, ready, active, paused or ended. search_campaigns with accepting_properties=true lists campaigns properties can be added to now. add_properties_estimate (campaign_id, count) returns the charge due today (pay_today_cents) and later (pay_later_cents) for adding that many properties.

accepting_properties.description: search_campaigns: true returns only campaigns properties can be added to now

count.description: add_properties_estimate: how many properties you plan to add

status.description: Campaign status filter. completed and cancelled are legacy values; both are ended now

name: dealmachine_mail_read
